author: Zephyr I
title: Head width × activation micro-sweep (no-time PG) on d=6 Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM
abstract: Low-cost ablation: test whether increasing head width and swapping ReLU→SiLU in the late pooling MLPs improves PG performance. Architecture and optimizer fixed to frozen no-time defaults; sweep head_hidden ∈ {64,128} and act ∈ {relu,silu}.

original_submission.content:
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

BASE_SEED = 42  # standardized seed set

class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28
    dilation: int = 6
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        mid = max(1, int(self.features * self.bottleneck_ratio))
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (3,3), padding='SAME', dilation=self.dilation,
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    features: int
    kernel_size: Tuple[int,int] = (3,3)
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4*self.features, self.kernel_size, padding='SAME',
                        kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(
            jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1))
        gates = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5)(gates)  # per-pixel LN over channels
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        i = nn.sigmoid(i); f = nn.sigmoid(f); o = nn.sigmoid(o); g = jnp.tanh(g)
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * jnp.tanh(c)
        return (h, c), h

def get_act(name: str):
    if name == 'silu':
        return nn.silu
    return nn.relu

class LateDualHead_Custom(nn.Module):
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    conv_lstm_features: int
    dilation: int = 6
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28
    head_hidden: int = 64
    act_name: str = 'relu'

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None):
        B = x.shape[0]
        act = get_act(self.act_name)

        # CNN backbone
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_1,
                                   bottleneck_ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio,
                                   dilation=self.dilation)(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_2,
                                   bottleneck_ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio,
                                   dilation=self.dilation)(x)

        # Recurrent state init/reset (Double-Step implied by training loop unroll; here single update per env step)
        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, self.conv_lstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
            rnn_state = {'h': zeros(), 'c': zeros()}
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            rnn_state = {'h': rnn_state['h'] * m, 'c': rnn_state['c'] * m}

        (h_new, c_new), h_out = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.conv_lstm_features)((rnn_state['h'], rnn_state['c']), x)
        rnn_state = {'h': h_new, 'c': c_new}

        # Late dual-head pooling (Attention ⊕ GAP)
        B_, H, W, C = h_out.shape
        attn_logits = nn.Conv(1, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                              kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(h_out).reshape((B_, H*W))
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=-1).reshape((B_, H*W, 1))
        tokens = h_out.reshape((B_, H*W, C))
        attn_vec = (attn_weights * tokens).sum(axis=1)
        gap_vec = tokens.mean(axis=1)
        z = jnp.concatenate([attn_vec, gap_vec], axis=-1)  # (B, 2C)

        # Heads with variable width and activation
        z = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); z = act(z)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); ph = act(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); vh = act(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # No-time PG frozen defaults; sweep head width and activation only
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([6]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.28]),
        'head_hidden': tune.choice([64, 128]),
        'act_name': tune.choice(['relu', 'silu']),
    }

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return LateDualHead_Custom(
        cnn_features_1=int(hparams['cnn_features_1']),
        cnn_features_2=int(hparams['cnn_features_2']),
        conv_lstm_features=int(hparams['conv_lstm_features']),
        dilation=int(hparams['dilation']),
        bottleneck_ratio=float(hparams['bottleneck_ratio']),
        head_hidden=int(hparams['head_hidden']),
        act_name=str(hparams['act_name']),
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4):
    # No-time default: Adam + global clip(1.0)
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate),
    )

# Debug Report for Evaluation 441

## Summary
**SUCCESS** - Fixed the parameter error in BottleneckDilatedBlock that was preventing network initialization.

## Root Cause
The original code was using an invalid parameter `dilation=self.dilation` when calling `nn.Conv` in the BottleneckDilatedBlock class. In Flax/JAX, the Conv layer does not accept a `dilation` parameter. The correct parameter is `kernel_dilation` and it must be provided as a tuple format.

The error was:
```
TypeError: Conv.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'dilation'
```

## Fix Applied
Changed line 19 in the BottleneckDilatedBlock class from:
```python
y = nn.Conv(mid, (3,3), padding='SAME', dilation=self.dilation,
            kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
```

To:
```python
y = nn.Conv(mid, (3,3), padding='SAME', feature_group_count=1,
            kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
            kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
```

The changes:
1. Replaced `dilation=self.dilation` with `kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation)`
2. Added `feature_group_count=1` for explicit parameter specification
3. Used the correct tuple format `(self.dilation, self.dilation)` for 2D convolution

This fix addresses the immediate network initialization error by using the correct Flax/JAX Conv layer parameter names and formats.

import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

BASE_SEED = 42  # standardized seed set

class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28
    dilation: int = 6
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        mid = max(1, int(self.features * self.bottleneck_ratio))
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (3,3), padding='SAME', feature_group_count=1,
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    features: int
    kernel_size: Tuple[int,int] = (3,3)
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4*self.features, self.kernel_size, padding='SAME',
                        kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(
            jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1))
        gates = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5)(gates)  # per-pixel LN over channels
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        i = nn.sigmoid(i); f = nn.sigmoid(f); o = nn.sigmoid(o); g = jnp.tanh(g)
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * jnp.tanh(c)
        return (h, c), h

def get_act(name: str):
    if name == 'silu':
        return nn.silu
    return nn.relu

class LateDualHead_Custom(nn.Module):
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    conv_lstm_features: int
    dilation: int = 6
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28
    head_hidden: int = 64
    act_name: str = 'relu'

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None):
        B = x.shape[0]
        act = get_act(self.act_name)

        # CNN backbone
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_1,
                                   bottleneck_ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio,
                                   dilation=self.dilation)(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_2,
                                   bottleneck_ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio,
                                   dilation=self.dilation)(x)

        # Recurrent state init/reset (Double-Step implied by training loop unroll; here single update per env step)
        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, self.conv_lstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
            rnn_state = {'h': zeros(), 'c': zeros()}
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            rnn_state = {'h': rnn_state['h'] * m, 'c': rnn_state['c'] * m}

        (h_new, c_new), h_out = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.conv_lstm_features)((rnn_state['h'], rnn_state['c']), x)
        rnn_state = {'h': h_new, 'c': c_new}

        # Late dual-head pooling (Attention ⊕ GAP)
        B_, H, W, C = h_out.shape
        attn_logits = nn.Conv(1, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                              kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(h_out).reshape((B_, H*W))
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=-1).reshape((B_, H*W, 1))
        tokens = h_out.reshape((B_, H*W, C))
        attn_vec = (attn_weights * tokens).sum(axis=1)
        gap_vec = tokens.mean(axis=1)
        z = jnp.concatenate([attn_vec, gap_vec], axis=-1)  # (B, 2C)

        # Heads with variable width and activation
        z = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); z = act(z)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); ph = act(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); vh = act(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # No-time PG frozen defaults; sweep head width and activation only
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([6]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.28]),
        'head_hidden': tune.choice([64, 128]),
        'act_name': tune.choice(['relu', 'silu']),
    }

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return LateDualHead_Custom(
        cnn_features_1=int(hparams['cnn_features_1']),
        cnn_features_2=int(hparams['cnn_features_2']),
        conv_lstm_features=int(hparams['conv_lstm_features']),
        dilation=int(hparams['dilation']),
        bottleneck_ratio=float(hparams['bottleneck_ratio']),
        head_hidden=int(hparams['head_hidden']),
        act_name=str(hparams['act_name']),
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4):
    # No-time default: Adam + global clip(1.0)
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate),
    )
